title: GHOvardhan
tagline: Multiple ERC4626 vaults, powered by our in-house highly accurate ML models. A powerful SDK for your aave-GHO needs, and an interactive UI with credit delegation marketplace
description:
# Project Description: GHOvardhan

## Overview

"GHOvardhan" is an innovative venture rooted in the cultural heritage of India's Govardhan festival. It symbolizes a bridge between tradition and digital advancement, aiming to bring prosperity in the digital realm. The platform is more than just a transactional site; it serves as a custodian of digital wealth, offering a variety of services related to cryptocurrency, specifically focusing on the GHO token.

## Key Features

### MultiStrategy ML-based Vaults
GHOvardhan introduces MultiStrategy Machine Learning-based Vaults. These vaults use advanced AI algorithms to optimize crypto investments, balancing risk and return effectively.

### Powerful SDK
The platform is equipped with a robust Software Development Kit (SDK) that enhances its functionality and user experience.

### Full-fledged Account Abstraction
Utilizing ERC4337 standard for account abstraction, GHOvardhan offers a seamless integration of smart accounts with its custom Bundler and Paymaster Infrastructure. This includes features like ERC712 and ERC2612 permits for secure transaction signing.

### In-house Highly Accurate ML Models
The platform boasts proprietary machine learning models that provide high accuracy in predicting cryptocurrency prices and market trends.

### Credit Delegation Extravaganza
GHOvardhan has incorporated a credit delegation feature, a crucial aspect of the Aave protocol, to revolutionize DeFi lending and borrowing practices.

 Interactive User Interface
The user interface of GHOvardhan is designed for interaction and ease of use, built using technologies like React, Node.js, Vite, and MongoDB.

Project Components

### GHOvardhan Vaults
These include:

1. **Long-Term Investment Vault** - Utilizes AI to create personalized investment portfolios based on user preferences and goals.
2. **IntraDay Vault** - Employs credit delegation for efficient intraday investments, using AI for day trading strategies.

Account Abstraction
The project leverages the ERC4337 standard for account abstraction, integrating smart accounts with social logins (email, Gmail, Twitter, etc.) and supporting multiple wallets (Metamask, WalletConnect, Coinbase).

ML Models
The ML models in GHOvardhan are trained on historical data and are capable of accurately predicting cryptocurrency prices, aiding in investment decisions.

Credit Delegation
GHOvardhan's credit delegation feature allows for a more inclusive and flexible lending system, connecting borrowers and lenders in a community-driven financial ecosystem.

Development and Deployment
The project is developed using Solidity, Viem.js, TypeScript, Vite Tailwind, React.js, Node.js, MongoDB, and Ethers.js. The frontend and backend are harmoniously integrated to provide a seamless user experience, with special attention to gasless transactions and multi-chain connectivity.
how_its_made:
The core of the project is our in-house ML models that we built from scratch using our own prediction models. These took a week to train, and giving astonishing results over a 6 month long (Jul'23 to Jan'24) period. The algorithm is developed by us, and isn't a simple fork of some common publicly available ML model.

Then comes our vaults, written in Solidity, and compiled and deployed using hardhat and viem for a typesafe functionality.
Both of these have ERC4626, ERC2612 Permit support, and support gasless transactions for GHO.

For account abstraction, we have used thirdweb's wallet, and have our own Paymaster and bundler infrastructure set up to enable gasless transactions for any ERC20 token.
All you have to do is sign the transaction message, and we handle the rest for you.

Our SDK is built on top of aave's v3 core contracts, deployed on sepolia. We offer abstraction over connecting to and calling different functions over these contracts.
Plus we have completely abstracted out the credit delegation flow, where you just have to tell who you want to send money to, and how much. Our SDK handles the rest.
It's plug and play, just enter your Private key and RPC provider.

To showcase all the amazing stuff we've built, we have our fully interactive website, with a deployed frontend, and a fully functional persistent backend, deployed on mongo database.
Here, you get access to our vaults with different investment strategies and our credit delegation marketplace, where we connect delegators with delegates.
Or, if you are into the fun stuff, give us your credits, and we'll use them for high yield high risk intraday trading.
The webapp is powered by: React, NodeJs, Ethers, Viems, ThirdWeb, Openzeppelin defender and our great development team ;)
